projects.title: Hybrid Telephony Workflows
projects.tagline: Unifying two mutually-exclusive calling modes into one account-level capability
projects.summary: Runo already supported SIM-based call tracking and Airtel IQ cloud telephony, but never together; an account got one or the other. This work unified both into one account-level capability, usable simultaneously in the same app.

metrics.label: Before
metrics.value: SIM tracking and cloud (Airtel IQ) — one or the other, per account

metrics.label: After
metrics.value: Both simultaneously, one account, one session

metrics.label: Attribution
metrics.value: callMedium threaded through activity and reports

timeline.title: Exclusivity audit
timeline.description: Confirmed SIM tracking and cloud (Airtel IQ) telephony were mutually exclusive per account — switching or adding a virtual number meant reconfiguring the account, not a toggle.

timeline.title: Unified state model
timeline.description: Replaced the either-or account flag with a single SIM / Cloud / Hybrid enum so both paths can be active on one account.

timeline.title: In-app selector and attribution
timeline.description: Shipped CallMediumSelector and threaded callMedium through logs and analytics so reporting reflects which path an actual call used.

projects.title: Product Analytics Pipeline
projects.tagline: Vendor-agnostic telemetry facade with offline buffering and time-windowed deduplication
projects.summary: Built a product analytics telemetry pipeline: a provider abstraction over Amplitude, typed event schemas, Hive-backed client buffering, and sliding-window deduplication.

metrics.label: Largest run
metrics.value: 45M events in one full reprocess (3-month window)

timeline.title: Telemetry audit
timeline.description: Mapped scattered tracking calls lacking shared schema validation, environment isolation, and retry behavior.

timeline.title: ProductAnalytics facade
timeline.description: Introduced AnalyticsProvider contract and typed user/account identity models.

timeline.title: Buffering and dedup rollout
timeline.description: Shipped Hive-backed event buffering and sliding-window deduplication middleware.

projects.title: WhatsApp Web CRM Sidecar
projects.tagline: Capturing WhatsApp Web conversations into a CRM with no official API
projects.summary: Built a Manifest V3 Chrome extension that syncs WhatsApp Web conversations into a CRM by resolving the app's own internal module stores at runtime, and pages chat history without ever changing the chat a rep is looking at.

metrics.label: Official API used
metrics.value: None — WhatsApp Business API does not cover reading a live personal Web session

metrics.label: Store discovery
metrics.value: Named module lookup first, structural matching as fallback

metrics.label: UI impact during sync
metrics.value: None — active chat verified unchanged across a full history page

timeline.title: Runtime store discovery
timeline.description: Located WhatsApp Web's Chat/Msg/Contact/Conn stores inside a minified webpack bundle by structural shape matching.

timeline.title: Two-tier rewrite
timeline.description: Switched to exact module-id lookup after a structural-typing false positive, keeping shape matching as a degradation path.

timeline.title: Background catch-up
timeline.description: Replaced UI-driven chat switching with direct history paging against the store.
